purpose: Governed subject-domain vocabulary. A subject_domain answers 'what field of knowledge is this evidence/object about?'. It is distinct from reference_layer (presentation/evidence standard), audience, and page_type.
rules: Controlled vocabulary existence is separate from evidence-active use.
A domain may be 'registered' without implying BISULFID currently holds verified evidence in that domain.
A domain becomes 'evidence_active' only when >=1 verified evidence record (main/data/evidence/) references it. This sprint activates none.
New domains enter only by evidence-backed amendment recorded in DECISION_LOG.
This registry does not assert any factual content; it names fields of knowledge only.
seed_provenance: Seed vocabulary drawn from existing ontology signals (chemical_field, industrial_signal, safety_context) in main/data/ontology/sulfur_terms.json. Seeding the vocabulary name is not an evidence claim.

subject_domains.label: Chemical nomenclature
subject_domains.notes: Vocabulary registered. CHEMICAL naming (IUPAC/-id vs -ide etc.). NOT customs/statistical goods classification — that is SD-CUSTOMS-CLASSIFICATION.

subject_domains.label: Customs / statistical goods classification
subject_domains.notes: Distinct from SD-NOMENCLATURE (chemical naming). This domain is about goods CLASSIFICATION nomenclatures used for trade/customs/statistics: WCO Harmonized System (HS) headings/subheadings and their official reproductions, national tariff codes, and statistical product groupings. A classification identity (e.g. HS 2022 2503.00) is a customs-classification fact, not a chemical-nomenclature fact. Domain evidence-activation (state -> evidence_active) is a separate governance act NOT performed here even though a verified classification evidence record now references it (matching how SD-TRADE stays registered): registering the domain vocabulary implies no publication, no route, no indexation.

subject_domains.label: Corporate financial disclosures (issuer-primary)
subject_domains.notes: Issuer-primary corporate ACCOUNTING/financial facts as disclosed by the reporting entity's own official audited/consolidated financial statements. Distinct from SD-TRADE (sovereign trade evidence) and SD-ECONOMICS. An issuer accounting line (e.g. a raw-material purchase value) is a fact about the ISSUER'S OWN ACCOUNTS — never a national statistic, import value, market size, physical volume, or economy-wide conclusion. Domain-activation deferred; registering the vocabulary implies no publication/route/indexation.
